title: Naval units in the Steampunk Dwarf look: a soot-iron steam paddle boat, a riveted steam ironclad and a steam barge, and the two warship portraits

recipes.editInstruction: Turn it into a steam paddle boat: the hull becomes soot-black riveted iron #3a3835 with a light grey #8a8580 rim; the red sail, mast and pennant become one tall copper #d06a2a smokestack puffing white steam; add a copper paddle wheel on the side and a small bright green #2bd94a lamp. Nothing red. Keep the boat shape, size, waterline, thick black outline and style the same, with nothing under the hull.
recipes.notes: The batch-4 cog as a soot-iron steam paddle boat, the shared hull's footprint and waterline (NAVAL_FACTIONS.md).

recipes.editInstruction: Turn it into a steam ironclad: the hull becomes soot-black riveted iron #3a3835 with a light grey #8a8580 rim and a copper band; the stone castle becomes a squat iron gun turret; the red sails, masts and pennants become two tall copper #d06a2a smokestacks puffing white steam; add small bright green #2bd94a lamps. Nothing red. Keep the ship shape, size, thick black outline and style the same, with nothing under the hull.
recipes.notes: The batch-4 carrack as a riveted steam ironclad.

recipes.editInstruction: Turn it into a steam barge: the hull becomes soot-black riveted iron #3a3835 with a light grey #8a8580 rim; the red tarp becomes dark brown leather #4a3426 tied with copper bands; the pennant pole becomes a short copper #d06a2a smokestack puffing white steam; add a small bright green #2bd94a lamp. Nothing red. Keep the oars, boat shape, size, thick black outline and style the same, with nothing under the hull.
recipes.notes: The batch-4 barge as a soot-iron steam barge with the cargo under leather.
